Default alias derived from a series code or a formula, plus transforms

default_alias.Rd

For a series code: lowercased, runs of non-alphanumerics collapsed to _, trimmed, prefixed with x_ if it would start with a digit. For a formula (formula = TRUE) the operators are spelled out first so they survive that step: + - * / ^ become _plus_ _minus_ _times_ _div_ _pow_, a leading - becomes neg_. Transforms are appended as suffixes in application order: _roll<n>, _<growth>, _idx<base>.

Usage

default_alias(x, growth = NA, index = NA, rolling = NA, formula = FALSE)

Arguments

x

character vector of series codes, or formulas if formula = TRUE

growth, index, rolling

the row's transform columns (NA when unused)

formula

logical, is x a formula rather than a code

Value

character vector of aliases matching ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$

Details

Deterministic, so it survives position edits; two rows collide only if they show the same thing — same code (or formula) with the same transforms.
